mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive monthly declines in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs and suppresses earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS increases and UNRATE declines signal an overheating economy where monetary policy fails to cool demand, triggering equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and UNRATE falls > 0.25pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances meeting the dual condition.

mechanism_narrative: Early-cycle expansions characterized by rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand and construction activity, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of early-cycle expansion periods with rising HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in residential investment (RSAFS) reflects improving household financial health and consumption capacity, increasing corporate revenue expectations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive monthly increases in RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth and inflation expectations, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent HOUST increases and INDPRO declines signal demand-supply misalignment where housing demand outpaces manufacturing capacity, causing market concerns about economic imbalances and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances meeting the dual condition.

mechanism_narrative: High labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0%) combined with rising PAYEMS signals accelerating wage pressures that trigger inflation concerns and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE < 4.0% and rising PAYEMS.
